method: Interleaved requests, separate curl connection per request, alternating order, 250ms gap. Identical minimal handler with original versus reduced site modules uploaded but never imported. No credentials, database, storage or service bindings. First observed instance is identified by X-Probe-Request: 1, it does not prove every Cloudflare platform cache was cold. After-connection time subtracts time_pretransfer from time_starttransfer and still includes network round-trip time. These measurements isolate Worker payload preparation, they are not production documentation TTFB measurements.

production.interpretation: The settled production median is effectively unchanged. Fresh deployments and real production traffic produce a changing cold/warm mixture. These small sequential samples do not establish a production cold-TTFB percentile improvement. The separate controlled payload comparison demonstrates a reduction in preparation latency, not a 55% end-to-end docs speedup. Long responses remain.
